//: 0007 R7/R9. Type-checking only -- `tsc` never emits here.
Node 24 strips types natively, so `node pipeline/run.ts` runs the
pipeline with no build step and no runtime dependency. What `tsc` is for
is the four @ts-expect-error cases in tests/schema.types.ts, which are
R7's whole acceptance: the types are not met by existing, only by
`erasableSyntaxOnly` is the load-bearing option. It refuses the TypeScript
constructs Node's stripper cannot erase -- enums, namespaces, parameter
properties -- so a contributor cannot write something that type-checks
here and fails to start there.
`allowImportingTsExtensions` because the imports are written with the
`.ts` extension, which is what Node resolves at runtime.
